notes: Desktop/wall-mount touchpanel (mounts to wall, furniture, glass, or rack via optional accessory) — no rack units set since it is not inherently rack-mounted hardware. Sole power input is Power over Ethernet (802.3af, Class 3) via the RJ-45 jack; there is no separate AC or DC power connector, so no discrete power port is listed. The 1 digital input uses a 3.5 mm 2-pole captive screw connector (pin 1 = digital in, pin 2 = ground) — mapped to the closest allowed connector id "euroblock" since a true 3.5mm captive-screw terminal block isn't in the list; note it's actually a mini/3.5mm-pitch screw terminal, not a full-size Euroblock. The USB port is a micro-B USB 2.0 device/peripheral port (not a host port), used for panel connectivity (e.g. to a PC) rather than connecting USB peripherals to the panel, so it is marked bidirectional per USB convention but functions as a device-side connection. Audio output is to 2 built-in mono speakers only — there is no external audio output jack, so no analog audio port is listed. No RS-232 or IR ports exist on this model (control/communication is via Ethernet only). Source: official Extron spec sheet PDF (doc 4357-D2-062118, TLP Pro 1025M Series and TLS 1025M), fetched via www.extron.com/download/files/specs/tlp_pro_1025m_series_6089-D6.pdf.
